_note: Stack / orbit / entry masses used by Dynamics.set_configuration. Liftoff stack is a public STS-1 round. Orbit and entry are [estimated] operating masses, not a payload-specific weigh sheet.

sources.locator: STS-1 liftoff mass commonly published as 4.5 million lb / 2.04e6 kg (rounded here to 2_040_000 kg)

stack.note: orbiter + ET + two SRB at SRB ignition

orbit.note: orbiter after ET sep, mid-mission propellant

entry.note: orbiter after OMS deorbit, gear up
